analogy.rationale: Drugs annotated as acetylcholine release enhancers here target MAOA/MAOB, so monoamine oxidase inhibitors share the same molecular targets and downstream monoamine signaling. Cholinesterase/acetylcholinesterase inhibitors also boost cholinergic signaling, but the transcriptional response in these cell lines is likely weak because neuronal acetylcholine release machinery is minimally expressed.
